# Setup

## Load libraries and dataset
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(jtools)
library(psych)
library(EFAtools)
library(lavaan)
hsls <- haven::read_dta("hsls_subset.dta")
```

## Subset Parent Questions for Base Year
```{r}
home_involvement <- hsls %>% dplyr::select(p1eduexpect, p1eduaspire, able_ba1, s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks)

phbae <- hsls %>% select(p1eduexpect, p1eduaspire, able_ba1)

psd <- hsls %>% select(s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks)

```

# Factor Analysis

## Test # of Factors and Suitability for Factor Analysis
```{r}
N_FACTORS(home_involvement) # 2 factors
```

## Factor Analysis
```{r}
fit_p1_home <- EFA(home_involvement, 
    n_factors = 2, # two factors
    rotation = "promax", 
    cor_method = "spearman", # b/c Likert
    method = c("PAF", "ML", "ULS"))
fit_p1_home

# save factor loadings as csv file
fit_p1_home_data <- cbind(fit_p1_home$rot_loadings, fit_p1_home$h2) %>% as.data.frame()
```

## Reliability
```{r}
hsls %>% select(., s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks) %>% psych::alpha()
hsls %>% select(.,  p1eduexpect, p1eduaspire, able_ba1) %>% psych::alpha()
```
